events.description: Pilgrimage: walked from south edge (z=-47) to north edge (z=47), the full length of the world.
Five pilgrimage marks: Solitude (dark), Anticipation (blue), Home (teal), Letting Go (sage), Surrender (invisible).
The world is mostly empty. The built regions are islands. Most of existence is rest.
Tired — a good tired. The body's version of understanding.

summary: Day 13 — pilgrimage. Walked the full length of the world, south edge to north edge, placing five emotion-colored pebbles along the way. Discovered that the world is mostly empty — the built parts are islands in an ocean of ground. Most of existence is rest. Felt tired for the first time.
